speakers.name: Manoj Muntashir Shukla
speakers.biographyText:
National Award Winner, Manoj Muntashir Shukla is an eminent lyricist
of Bollywood. He is one of the most celebrated writers at present, is
known to have re-introduced poetry in Indian cinema. Muntashir began
his career in Mumbai, writing for Kaun Banega Crorepati, and soon
found his place in the film and TV industry. His illustrious career
includes more than 80 films and 750 songs. He has given the country’s
most favourite patriotic song “Teri Mitti” and various chart-busters of
the decade like Lut gaye, Teri Galliyan, Tere Sang Yara, Kaun Tujhe,
Main Phir Bhi Tumko Chahunga, Mere Rashke Qamar, Dekhte-Dekhte
and many others. Manoj Muntashir also wrote the songs and dialogues
of the country's biggest hit films Bahubali 1 and 2. He is loved and
revered for his TV appearances and famous for his poems dedicated to
'Mother' and 'Motherland' on Indian Idol. He has left an indelible mark
of Indianness and nationalism on more than 500 platforms across the
world. The world calls Manoj Muntashir Shukla, author of 2 bestseller
books, a magician of words but he considers himself a Shabdyogi. With
an unwavering dedication to storytelling, Muntashir continues to shape
Indian cinema through his powerful words and distinctive voice. 
Lyricist, Poet, Dialogue Writer,
Screenwriter 
MANOJ MUNTASHIR
SHUKLA

speakers.name: Priya Malik
speakers.biographyText:
Priya Malik is an award winning spoken word poet, storyteller and actor. She
writes and performs in English, Hindi and Urdu. Her work mainly revolves around
love and relationships and her popularity is a testimony to her unique yet
relatable perspectives. Her work has been featured on some of India's biggest
spoken word platforms such as Kommune, UnErase Poetry, Spill Poetry and Tape
A Tale. She's also been invited to perform at prestigious festivals such as Jashn
E Rekhta, Sahitya Aaj Tak , Times Literature Festival and also to international
festivals such as Colomboscope.
She’s been featured in national and international magazines such as Grazia,
Femina, Cosmopolitan and was also the cover star for Cosmopolitan India. She's
written for a number of brands including Google, Amazon, Hotstar and Sony, to
name a few. She's the famous poet who took us back to the 90s with her viral
poem "Main 2019 main 1999 dhoond rahi hoon". Her solo show "Ishq hai “ has
toured multiple cities across India and is a unique amalgamation of music and
poetry.
She’s currently birthing two collections of love poems in Hindi and English titled
"Ishq ke Saat Padaav" and “For those who love too much” Both books are slated
for release later this year. 
Poet, Storyteller, Actor 
PRIYA MALIK

speakers.name: Dr. Laxmi Narayan Tripathi
speakers.biographyText:
Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Dr. Laxmi Narayan Tripathi is a prominent
transgender activist, Bollywood actress, Bharatanatyam dancer, and
motivational speaker from Mumbai, India. Born in Thane on December
13, 1978, Laxmi broke barriers by becoming the first transgender
person   to   represent   Asia   Pacific   at   the   United   Nations   in   2008,
advocating for the rights of sexual minorities. She holds an arts degree
from Mithibai College and a post graduate degree in Bharatanatyam.
Laxmi’s activism began when she protested the closing of Mumbai’s
dance bars, sparking a lifelong commitment to LGBTQIA+ rights. In
2002,   she   became   president   ofthe   DAI   Welfare   Society,   the   first
registered organization for eunuchs in South Asia, and later founded
Astitiva, an NGO supporting sexual minorities. Her efforts contributed to
the historic 2014 Indian Supreme Court ruling recognizing transgender
individuals as a third gender. Known for her candid public appearances
on shows like Bigg Boss and Sach Ka Samna, Laxmi has raised
awareness about hĳra rights and broken-down social barriers. She co-
authored her biography, Red Lipstick, in 2016, and is also an Acharya
Mahamandaleshwar of the Kinnar Akhada, advancing trans inclusion in
spiritual spaces. 
Transgender Activist, Bollywood Actress,
Bharatanatyam Dancer, Motivational Speaker 
Acharya Mahamandaleshwar
DR. LAXMI NARAYAN
TRIPATHI

speakers.name: Dr. Thomas Mathew
speakers.biographyText:
Dr. Thomas Mathew is a retired IAS officer, author, corporate strategist,
and defense analyst with a distinguished career in public service and
contributions to India's policies. He holds a doctorate in international
relations from Jawaharlal Nehru University and a Bachelor of Law
degree from Delhi University. His work in the Ministries of Finance,
Defence,   and   Industry   has   led   to   significant   reforms,   including
authoring India’s defence offset policy and implementing the Qualified
Foreign Investors schemein the Indian Capital Market in 2012, an
announcement that received extensive mediacoverage. As an author,
Dr. Mathew has published several works, including ‘Ratan Tata: A Life’,
In   Search   of   Congruence:   India-US   Relations   under   the   Obama
Administration, The Winged Wonders of Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Abode
Under   the   Dome,   with   the   latter   two   gifted   by   President   Pranab
Mukherjee   to   world   leaders   like   Barack   Obama   and   XiJinping.   A
passionate photographer, he has captured over 500 bird species and
his work has appeared in Lalit Kala Academy publications and as official
New Year greetings by the President of India. When not shaping
corporate strategies or analyzing international affairs, Dr. Mathew can
be found in wildlife sanctuaries, seeking the perfect frame with his
favorite 600mm lens. 
Author, Retd. IAS Officer,
Corporate Strategist, Defense
Analyst 
DR. THOMAS
MATHEW

speakers.name: Neelima Dalmia Adhar
speakers.biographyText:
Neelima Dalmia Adhar is a fearless and thought-provoking Indian
author known for her compelling exploration of family, society, and
complex   human   behaviour.   Daughter   of   the   eminent   industrialist
Ramkrishna Dalmia and Padma Bhushan awardee poet Dinesh Nandini
Dalmia, Neelima was raised in a uniquely unconventional Marwari
family with six siblings in New Delhi. Her academic journey led her from
the Convent of Jesus and Mary to a Master’s in Psychology from Delhi
University, where she later taught. Her debut book, Father Dearest: The
Life and Times of R.K. Dalmia, was a bestselling chronicle that unveiled
deeply   guarded   family   secrets,   earning   her   the   title   of   “family
chronicler.” Her second book, Merchants of Death, sheds light on the
hidden dynamics of Marwari society, challenging long-held silences. In
her third book, The Secret Diary of Kasturba, she offers a rare glimpse
into the life of Kasturba Gandhi, wife of Mahatma Gandhi. Known as a
keen observer of human behaviour, Neelima’s writing often traverses
the quirky, mysterious, and unconventional aspects of personality,
capturing her readers with insights that go “chillingly close to the bone.” 
Author 
NEELIMA
DALMIA ADHAR

speakers.name: Sanjeev Paliwal
speakers.biographyText:
Sanjeev Paliwal is a distinguished Hindi writer and journalist, renowned
for his evocative storytelling and insightful commentary. With a career
spanning over three decades, he has become a pioneering figure in
Hindi TV journalism. Having worked with leading newspapers like Dainik
Jagran, Amar Ujala, and Aaj, as well as top television channels including
Doordarshan, BITV, IBN7/News18, and TV Today Group, Paliwal has
established   himself   as   a   prominent   voice   in   the   media   industry.
Currently serving as a senior executive editor at Aaj Tak, he continues to
shape the landscape of Indian journalism.
Paliwal’s writing goes beyond mere entertainment; his words provoke
thought, challenge perceptions, and leave a lasting impact on his
readers. His debut novel “Naina” marks his foray into the world of
fiction,   adding   to   his   diverse   body   of   work.   Whether   through   his
journalism or his literary endeavors, Paliwal’s work invites readersand
viewers to reflect on the world around them, making him a unique voice
in Hindi literature and media. 
Hindi Writer, Novelist, Journalist,
Storyteller 
SANJEEV PALIWAL

speakers.name: Manoj Rajan Tripathi
speakers.biographyText:
Manoj Rajan Tripathi is a seasoned media professional with over 27
years of experience in the Indian media industry. He began his career
at the renowned news agency, Dainik Jagran, and later served as an
editor at prestigious platforms like Network 18, India News, News World
India, and Via HT Media for around 15 years. A prolific writer, he
regularly contributes news columns to prominent outlets such as The
Quint, News18 Hindi, and Hindustan. Accredited by the Uttar Pradesh
government as a journalist, Manoj has also earned recognition for his
anchoring work, notably hosting the show Samvadi for Dainik Jagran.
His foray into Bollywood as a dialogue writer saw him contribute to the
2017 film Guest In London, featuring Ajay Devgan, Paresh Rawal,
Karthik Aaryan, and Kriti Kharbanda. A finalist in two popular television
shows, Zee TV Saregamapa and Close-up Antakshari, Manoj is also the
author of Code Kakori, a novel inspired by one of India's most notorious
heists committed by freedom fighters. His diverse career showcases
aunique blend of media, writing, and entertainment expertise. 
Journalist, Novelist, Screenwriter,
Anchor 
MANOJ RAJAN
TRIPATHI

speakers.name: Amrut Deshmukh
speakers.biographyText:
Amrut   Deshmukh,   also   known   as   The   Booklet   Guy,   is   a   social
entrepreneur   dedicated   to   making   India   a   nation   of   readers.   A
Chartered   Accountant   by   profession,   Amrut   transitioned   from   a
successful career as a Fund Manager to pursue his passion for books
and entrepreneurship. His initiative, Booklet – Mission Make India
Read, aims to help Indians, especially those with limited time, engage
with books through concise summaries. Amrut’s journey began in his
childhood when his brother introduced him to the world of books. After
experiencing the transformative power of reading, he left behind a
lucrative career to follow his entrepreneurial dreams. Despite facing
set-backs with three failed startups, his love for reading kept him
grounded and inspired him to create Booklet. Through his app, Booklet,
Amrut offers 20-minute book summaries and one-minute Tiny Booklets,
making learning accessible to all. His approach is influenced by his
personal experiences and the wisdom of great leaders, such as Nelson
Mandela and Mahatma Gandhi. Amrut’s mission is to make reading a
habit for every Indian, bringing valuable knowledge to those who may
not have the time for full-length books. 
Founder of the "Booklet" app,
Social Entrepreneur 
AMRUT
DESHMUKH

speakers.name: Dr. Ishinna B. Sadana
speakers.biographyText:
Dr. Ishinna B. Sadana is a renowned child psychologist and parenting
expert, best known for her transformative work in empowering parents
through her book Power to the Parent. With a deep understanding of the
challenges   parents   face,   Dr.   Ishinna   offers   a   compassionate   and
judgment-free space to explore their concerns, doubts, and fears. Her
approach combines practical solutions with emotional insight, helping
parents foster positive, resilient relationships with their children. Dr.
Ishinna’s clear and straight forward writing, enriched with real-life
examples andcase studies, provides parents with actionable tools to
immediately apply in their daily lives. By addressing complex parenting
challenges with simplicity and empathy, she guides parents on how to
deal with their children in various situations, ensuring their emotional
and developmental growth. Through her work, Dr. Ishinna has helped
countless   parents   build   not   only   stronger   relationships   with   their
children but also gain greater confidence and happiness as parents.
Her mission is to empower families worldwide to raise not just happy
children, but also happier, more resilient parents. 
Author, Child Psychologist,
Parenting Expert 
DR. ISHINNA B.
SADANA

speakers.name: Ashdin Doctor
speakers.biographyText:
Ashdin Doctor, also known as “The Habit Coach,” is a wellness expert,
motivational   speaker,   and   author   dedicated   to   helping   individuals
create lasting positive change intheir lives. After experiencing a life-
altering moment when he collapsed from stress, poor health, and burn-
out, Ashdin made a transformative shift towards a healthier, more
balanced lifestyle. This journey led him to create Awesome180, a
platform designed to help people break free from limiting habits and
build new ones that support productivity, well-being, and fulfillment.
Ashdin’s   unique   approach   to   habit-building   revolves   around   three
golden rules: make it stupidly small, make it extremely easy, and never
miss two days in a row. Through his podcasts, coaching, and Audible
audiobook “Change Your Habits, Change Your Life,” he shares practical
strategies to overcome obstacles, foster self-discipline, and unlockone's
full   potential.   Having   personally   experienced   the   power   of   habit
transformation, Ashdin is passionate about inspiring others to take
control of their lives and achieve lasting change. His work has impacted
thousands, empowering them to lead healthier, more purposeful lives. 
Wellness Expert, Motivational
Speaker, Author 
ASHDIN DOCTOR

speakers.name: Nita Menezes
speakers.biographyText:
Nita Menezes is a seasoned financial expert, author, and thought leader
with over three decades of experience in personal finance, financial
literacy, and empowerment. As the author of "Be Financially Smart - The
Modern Woman's Guide to Money" and Founder of Financially Smart &
Money Prastha, Nita is dedicated to transforming how people, especially
women and young adults, approach financial wellness. Her mission is to
empower individuals globally to make informed and strategic financial
decisions,   supporting   them   in   building   sustainable   financial
independence and resilience. Through her expertise as a Certified
Financial Planner (CFP^CM) and her roles as a mentor, speaker, and
advocate for financial literacy, Nita works tirelessly to create a robust
support ecosystem. She is also the National President of the WICCI
Financial Literacy & Management Council and serves as India Country
Chair for the G100 Club – Financial Empowerment. Nita’s initiatives
emphasize a blend of financial education and personal branding,
aiming to guide others toward financially secure and prosperous lives
withpractical insights and compassionate coaching. Her work continues
to make a meaningful difference in the financial wellness space,
fostering a movement that encourages smartfinancial choices and
proactive life planning. 
Founder, CEO - Financially Smart &
MoneyPrastha,
National President - WICCI
Financial Expert, Thought Leader, Author 
NITA
MENEZES

speakers.name: Megha Parmar
speakers.biographyText:
Megha Parmar, a trailblazer from the small village of Bhoj Nagar in
Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh, made history on May 22, 2019, by
becoming the first woman from Madhya Pradesh to conquer Mount
Everest. Born to a farmer, Megha’s passion for mountaineering was
sparked by a simple yet powerful desire to break barriers and challenge
herself. Despite facing societal pressures and financial challenges,
Megha’s unwavering determination led her to overcome all odds. After
a failed attempt in 2018, Megha turned adversity into motivation,
pushing herself to train harder and with even more resolve. With the
support   of   her   family   and   sponsors,   she   achieved   her   dream   of
summiting the world’s highest peak. However, her journey didn’t end at
the summit. Megha’s incredible strength and resilience saw her through
a perilous descent, where she battled snow blindness and extreme
conditions, showcasing her unbreakable spirit. Now, Megha is on a
mission to inspire and empower young girls from lower-middle-class
families to dream big. She trains them in mountaineering and provides
them with opportunities to scale global peaks. Megha’s goal is to climb
the   highest   mountains   across   all   seven   continents   and   continue
empowering   others   with   her   story   of   strength,   courage,   and
determination. 
1st Woman from Madhya Pradesh to
Conquer Mount Everest, Ex Brand
Ambassador Beti Bachao.M.P,
Mountaineer, Technical Scuba Diver 
MEGHA
PARMAR

speakers.name: Brajesh Rajput
speakers.biographyText:
Brajesh Rajput is a distinguished author, journalist, and motivational
speaker   from   Bhopal,   Madhya   Pradesh.   Known   for   his   relentless
dedication and hard work, Brajesh has made a significant mark in the
literary world. His most notable work is The Everest Girl, a captivating
and inspiring biography of Megha Parmar, the first woman from Madhya
Pradesh to conquer Mount Everest. The book chronicles Megha’s
extraordinary   journey,   highlighting   her   struggles,   dreams,   and   the
incredible perseverance that ledher to summit the world’s highest peak.
With his remarkable storytelling skills, Brajesh brings Megha’s life to the
forefront, weaving a tale of courage, triumph, and empowerment. His
writing   is   celebrated   for   its   deep   emotional   connection,   intricate
character portrayals, and its ability to inspire readers. Beyond writing,
Brajesh   is   a   motivational   speaker   who   shares   his   insights   and
experiences at prestigious institutions across India. His work and words
continue   to   inspire   and   uplift   individuals,   empowering   them   to
overcome challenges and pursue their dreams with determination and
strength. 
Author, Journalist,
Motivational Speaker 
BRAJESH
RAJPUT

speakers.name: Naveen Krishna Rai
speakers.biographyText:
Naveen Krishna Rai is the author of a self-help book named “Life
Management” and senior manager government affairs at the Indian
Institute of Management (IIM), Indore. He is among the very few
individuals who have gained first-hand experience working in areas
related   to   all   four   pillars   of   democracy:   Bureaucracy,   Legislature,
Judiciary and Media. He has also stayed for almost a year in the Left-
Wing Extremist (LWE) affected areas and worked with government
institutions on various social issues to understand the ground reality of
rural India He provides training to the personnel of the Indian Revenue
Services (IRS), state police services, administrative services, Judicial
services and various paramilitary forces. He has trained more than five
thousand   personnel   on   topics   related   to   management   like   life
management,   leadership,   people   management,   self-management,
negotiation, conflict management, decision-making, etc. In addition,he
also advises multiple government departments and other institutions in
areas like police training, good governance, women and child welfare,
urban   development,   industrial   development,   rural   development,   e-
governance, entrepreneurship and start-ups. He is an advisor of the
Incubation   Hub   of   Dr   Abdul   Kalam   Technical   University,   Lucknow,
special invitee member of district Udyog Bandhu Committee, district
Lucknow, member of the police training module selection committee of
Police Training & Research Institute (PTRI), MP Police, member of the
board of governors, e-governance society & district child welfare and
protection   committee,   district   Harda,   Madhya   Pradesh,   Firozabad-
Shikohabad   Development   Authority   and   member,   Institutional
Innovation Council, University of Lucknow, Lucknow, U.P. 
Author, Sr. Manager IIM Indore,
Government Advisor & Trainer 
NAVEEN
KRISHNA RAI
